title: The United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, as the UN publishes it (XML)

landmarks: root CONSOLIDATED_LIST with a dateGenerated attribute
each INDIVIDUAL or ENTITY with REFERENCE_NUMBER, FIRST_NAME (…FOURTH_NAME), UN_LIST_TYPE, LISTED_ON, *_ALIAS (QUALITY, ALIAS_NAME), *_ADDRESS (COUNTRY, CITY, STREET, …)

signals_note: GET https://scsanctions.un.org/resources/xml/en/consolidated.xml (it redirects to a signed blob on unsolprodfiles.blob.core.windows.net); HELD on the UN's terms (personal, non-commercial use; no compiling or derivative works) until the position carries `authorised: un-sc`. Read in memory on 21 October 2026: 736 individuals, 274 entities, 14 regimes, every REFERENCE_NUMBER unique, dateGenerated 2026-10-20T23:00:05.952Z.
notes: The XML states no total; items in = listings + set aside. COMMENTS1 (narrative), INDIVIDUAL_DOCUMENT (passports) and every address part but COUNTRY are never read. main.un.org (the list's HTML page, which states counts) answered 202 with an empty body to the one read on 21 October 2026: a challenge, not retried.
applies_to: the UN consolidated list, from 21 October 2026 (held)
process: One listing per INDIVIDUAL and ENTITY, keyed sanctions/un-sc/<REFERENCE_NUMBER>.

Name: FIRST to FOURTH_NAME joined as published; aliases each once; NAME_ORIGINAL_SCRIPT; TITLE and DESIGNATION values; NATIONALITY values; birth dates as DATE, YEAR or FROM_YEAR-TO_YEAR; PLACE_OF_BIRTH COUNTRY; ADDRESS COUNTRY only.
Basis: the regime (UN_LIST_TYPE), given effect under the United Nations Act 1946; LISTED_ON as designated; the latest LAST_DAY_UPDATED as updated.
gates: Every INDIVIDUAL and ENTITY is a listing or a catch-log line.
No address part but a country, no document number, no comment on any row.

title: The New Zealand Police workbook of designated terrorist entities (Terrorism Suppression Act 2002), with the Resolution 1373 page that states its count

landmarks: sheets Information, Individuals, Organisations, Revocations, UNSCR 1373, UNSCR 1373 Expirations

Individuals header: ID, LastName, Name_1…Name_4, Title, POB_n, POB_n_Country, DOB_1…DOB_9, Nationality_1…3, Associated with, Passport…, Address…, NZ_designation_date, Entry Date 2, Sanctions_List_Permanent_Reference_Numbe(r)
UNSCR 1373 header: NZ UNSCR 1373 ID CODE, NAME, ABBREV, COUNTRY, DATE OF ORIGINAL DESIGNATION, DATE/S DESIGNATION RENEWED, DATE OF DESIGNATION EXPIRATION…
Revocations: a one-cell section row 'INDIVIDUALS REVOKED BY UN/NZ', later 'ORGANISATIONS REVOKED BY UN/NZ'

signals_note: The workbook is linked from the resolutions 1267/1989/2253/1988 page (designated-entities-<day>.xlsx, 'current as at 2 October 2026'); the 1373 page states 'New Zealand currently has N non-UN listed entities'. HELD on Police's copyright statement (non-commercial private purposes only) until `authorised: nz-police-tsa`. Read in memory 21 October 2026.
notes: An integer ID is a listing and each decimal an alias of it (Information sheet, note 3); IDs arrive as floats ('2.0099999999999998') or with a space ('913. 00'). Dates are spreadsheet serials or dd/mm/yyyy text. 'Associated with' 1 = Taliban (TA…), 2 = Al-Qaida (QD…). One 1373 individual is written 'NAME, DOB <day>' in the NAME cell. On 21 October 2026 the 1373 sheet held 21 current designations and the page said 22.
applies_to: the Police designated entities workbook, from 21 October 2026 (held)
process: Group each sheet's rows by ID base; the lowest decimal is the listing, the rest its aliases.

Individuals and Organisations: designated, the UN reference as other_ref, the regime from its prefix; NZ_designation_date; the last dd/mm/yyyy in Entry Date 2 as updated. Address and passport columns are never read.
UNSCR 1373: New Zealand's designations: original date, renewals, expiry unless renewed; Expirations: ended on the expiry date. Revocations: ended on NZ_revocation_date.
Keys: sanctions/nz-police-tsa/individual/<id>, entity/<id>, 1373/<id>; an identifier listed twice is set aside.
gates: Every ID group is a listing or a catch-log line.
The current 1373 designations against the page's stated count (check.py).

title: MFAT's Russia Sanctions Register (Russia Sanctions Act 2022), the workbook as published (XLSX); UNVERIFIED against a real file

landmarks: a sheet with a header row containing 'Unique Identifier', 'Type' and 'DOB'

columns named: First name, Middle name(s), Last name, Title, Alias/Alternate Spellings, Citizenship (2, 3), Place of Birth, Date of Sanction, Date of Additional Sanction, Sanction Status, General Rationale for Sanction, Asset Freeze, Travel Ban, Service Prohibition, Dealing with Securities, Ship Ban, Aircraft Ban
Type values Individual, Entity, Bank; Asset and Total rows

signals_note: The landmarks are taken from a published description of the workbook (the OpenSanctions crawler for this dataset, read 21 October 2026), NOT from the workbook: MFAT's terms of use bar automated access and the file sits behind a bot wall. A person downloads it in a browser and lands it with `capture.py --file`; the first such file confirms these landmarks or a version 2 follows. A file without the header is set aside whole.
notes: Which name column holds an entity's name is not known: the reader joins First, Middle and Last as published. A Unique Identifier may repeat: the second is keyed apart by its name. The Total row's figure, if it carries one, is the list's stated count. Address, Passport Number, Associates/Relatives, Additional Information and General Rationale are never read.
applies_to: MFAT's Russia Sanctions Register (updated 9 September 2026 at the last look), landed by hand
process: Find the header row on each sheet; read every row below it.
Individual, Entity and Bank rows are listings; Asset and Total rows are counted; any other Type is set aside.
Status 'revoked' when Sanction Status says so; the sanction types marked as the regime.
gates: Every data row is a listing, a counted row or a catch-log line.
Listings against the Total row's figure where it has one (check.py).
